title: sbH - occupation

Graph connections

Root

  • sbH - glory

Meaning

occupation · Lemma سَبْح

Surahs (2)

  • 073 Al-Muzzammil
  • 079 An-Naziat

Verses (full text)

Arabic + English (Sahih International) + English (Yusuf Ali) + Urdu. Showing up to 10 verses in (web app shows all).

73:7 · 073 Al-Muzzammil

إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا

Word in this verse: سَبْحًۭا — (is) occupation

English (Sahih International): Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.

English (Yusuf Ali): True, there is for thee by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties:

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): دن کے وقت تو تمہیں اور بہت سے شغل ہوتے ہیں

79:3 · 079 An-Naziat

وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا

Word in this verse: سَبْحًۭا — swimming

English (Sahih International): And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming

English (Yusuf Ali): And by those who glide along (on errands of mercy),

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور ان کی جو تیرتے پھرتے ہیں
